divergences.description: Story 1.2 limits `lib/core/widgets/` to stateless, feature-agnostic presentation primitives with no feature imports. `AppDrawer` sits in `core/widgets` but is a StatefulWidget, kept stateful for its double-tap guard. It also imports `core/navigation/app_router.dart`, which pulls in `features/auth` (AuthCubit, AuthScreen, SessionRepository). Story 1.6's Code Map places the drawer in `core/widgets` but never reconciles this with the 1.2 rule. The 1.6 review finding records the double-tap guard but not the break from the stateless, feature-agnostic boundary.
